pages.title: Doll Commander
pages.text: The Seven-Colored Doll Glove lets you command all of your dolls from a distance. Hold the selection key to open its mode wheel, then use the glove to give an order. A selected target is highlighted in the mode's color.

$(bold)Rally$()$(br)Summons all stored dolls, or recalls all active dolls.$(br)$(bold)Attack$()$(br)Commands every armed doll to fire once, one after another.$(br)$(bold)Skill$()$(br)Commands one random doll to use its super attack. It is listed only while a doll can perform it.

$(bold)Suicide$()$(br)Commands one random doll to rush the enemy and detonate. It is listed only while a doll carries TNT.$(br)$(bold)Loadout$()$(br)Right-click one of your dolls to open its loadout from afar, in any mode.$(br)$(bold)Left-click$()$(br)Left-click, even at empty air, issues the attack order without ever opening a menu.
